name: io.github.jyswee/oddsockets-cli
description: Agent-first real-time messaging: pub/sub, presence, history. Self-provision an app and get 12 tools over remote SSE — no dashboard, no keys to wire.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using your OddSockets API key: 'Bearer ak_...'. Optional: without one the server starts in onboarding mode and can self-provision an app via the oddsockets_signup tool.
